instr: Naɗe takarda: ana naɗe takarda sannan a huda rami a cikinta; ku zaɓi yadda takardar za ta kasance idan aka buɗe ta.
clue: Hotunan suna nuna yadda ake naɗe takarda mai siffar murabba'i (ɓangaren da aka yi wa inuwa yana naɗewa a kan layin ɗigo-ɗigo, kamar yadda kibiyar ta nuna). A hoton ƙarshe, an huda rami ta cikin dukkan naɗe-naɗen. Wace takarda cikin huɗun ke nuna inda ramukan suke idan aka sake buɗe takardar? Ku danna takarda ɗaya, ko ku danna lambarta daga 1 zuwa 4. Ku danna Fara idan kun shirya.
options: Wace takarda ce daidai idan aka buɗe ta?
